supported_operating_region.summary: F2 DC curve-fit fidelity is limited to Typical forward voltage, Ta = 25 degC curve (p. 3 Fig. 3), under Ta = 25 degC curve of the four-temperature family figure; family-typical MM3Z-series forward characteristic, not specific to MM3Z9V1; the linear forward voltage axis spans 0.72 to 0.978 V and the log forward current axis spans 0.005 to 0.2 A. Forward-current operating points have no independent voltage bias. Separate scalar hard bounds do not extend the fitted claim.

numeric_bounds.conditions: Selected F2 curve x axis: Typical forward voltage, Ta = 25 degC curve
Selected F2 curve y axis: Typical forward voltage, Ta = 25 degC curve
Ta = 25 degC curve of the four-temperature family figure; family-typical MM3Z-series forward characteristic, not specific to MM3Z9V1

known_omissions: AC, transient, noise, thermal, and package-parasitic behavior are outside this DC-only conveyor package.
Temperature dependence and self-heating are not modelled; the electrical region is limited to the cited nominal-temperature data.
Catalog parametrics were used only as initial guesses or F1 fallback constraints and are not datasheet citations.

F2 curve-fit fidelity is limited to the exact selected 25 degC DC curve, axes, conditions, and sampled range named in supported_operating_region; separate scalar hard bounds do not extend the fitted claim.
Reverse-bias, capacitance, switching, thermal, and temperature-dependence fidelity are outside the F2 curve-fit claim unless separately enforced as a scalar hard bound.
